text:
Predicates:
Square(x) ::: x is a square.
FourSides(x) ::: x has four sides.
Shape(x) ::: x is a shape.
Premises:
∀x (Square(x) → FourSides(x)) ::: All squares have four sides.
∀x (FourSides(x) → Shape(x)) ::: All four-sided things are shapes.
Conclusion:
∀x (Square(x) → Shape(x)) ::: All squares are shapes.
